name: Becoming Magical Girl Volta
source: "A short and silly visual novel about an office worker woman who found an odd mascot type creature in the washing machine and somehow got roped into being a magical girl to fight evil. Silliness ensues. Magical~ silliness~!"
translation: “一部短小而愚蠢的视觉小说，讲述了一名办公室女职员在洗衣机里发现了一个奇怪的吉祥物类型的生物，并不知何故被拉扯成为一名魔法少女来对抗邪恶。愚蠢随之而来。神奇〜愚蠢〜！”
